submission.bindingBasis: Planning evidence shows the workspace is clean and ready to close; the intended consequence is to close the Workspace and release its local materialization. The owner contract allows workspace.close without an expectedSourceStateDigest, so acting unbound avoids the risk of a mismatched digest failing as not_committed while still accomplishing the close.
submission.rationale: The planning evidence indicates the workspace is clean and ready to close. The owner contract explicitly permits workspace.close to omit expectedSourceStateDigest, so an unbounded close will succeed regardless of any concurrent state change and avoids a not_committed failure from a stale digest. This achieves the intended consequence (closing the workspace and releasing its local materialization) without requiring re-observation or holding.
